algorithm.longdouble_conversion: Exact stored binary-rational values with roundtrip guards; no binary64 downcast.

algorithm.same_trajectory_control: Native and double-step Simpson on the same fine history.

interpretation.negative: Identify failed consistency criterion or no demonstrated post-source gate-scale attribution; no fallback threshold or segment selection.
interpretation.positive: Demonstrates post-source Simpson error at original Ward gate scale only; supports a later separately registered source-free ledger replacement.

nature: Separately register a saved-data diagnosis of the known failed trial before this diagnostic is executed; no claim of blind original-experiment preregistration.
purpose: Distinguish Simpson ledger error from free-flow and stress reconstruction inconsistency after the source, without evaluating the source again.
